Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the clear recap. A few clarifications from our side that will help prioritize items in the checklist:

Decision criteria (priority = MUST / NICE):
- Latency: MUST — target user-facing P95 inference latency <= 500ms for single-turn responses (we can provide sample prompt sizes).
- Cost: MUST — target inference cost that keeps incremental cost to product < $200 / 1M tokens (we're flexible on model size if you can show tradeoffs).
- Deployment mode: MUST — prefer Private VPC deployment (data residency + network controls). Dedicated is acceptable if we get equivalent network isolation and contractual controls.
- SLA: MUST — minimum 99.9% availability for the inference endpoint; additionally want SLO/alerting hooks and error budget visibility.
- Security/compliance: MUST — SOC 2 Type II (or evidence of controls), encryption in transit and at rest, and KMS integration for keys. Rajiv will provide a checklist during the procurement call.

Stakeholders:
- Economic buyer: Tom Hastings (me, CTO)
- Procurement: Elena Ruiz (cc)
- Security: Rajiv Singh (cc)
- Implementation lead: TBD (I'll loop in product lead once we validate costs)

Procurement notes:
- Elena: we'll need a standard PO + Statement of Work. We typically run a two-week review of legal/SOW once we have the pricing and the SLA language.

Next steps:
- I'll fill the attached checklist with the priority labels and the latency/cost targets above by EOD tomorrow.
- Yes to a 30-min meeting next week — Elena/Rajiv available on Tue/Wed morning (PT).

Thanks,
Tom

Marissa / Laura —

Quick internal note for the thread so Finova has a recommended path forward:

Feasibility & options (high level):
- Option A (Private VPC): aligns with Finova's preference. We can deploy Redwood Private into a customer VPC with direct peering and KMS integration. Expected P95 latency: 200-450ms depending on model size and prompt length (we'll run a short latency matrix). Incremental cost is higher due to dedicated infra, but better for data controls.
- Option B (Dedicated): reserved GPU pool in our Dedicated offering. Lower operational lift for Finova and faster time-to-production. P95 latency typically 250-600ms depending on provisioning and batching. Cost is more predictable with committed capacity.

Tradeoffs & ask from Finova:
- If the P95 <= 500ms is a hard must, we should validate with a 1k-sample prompt set to confirm quantization/model choices.
- For cost targets (~<$200 / 1M tokens), we need samples of your expected peak QPS and token lengths to size batching / cache effectively.

I'll prepare a short table mapping model variant -> expected P95 -> estimated cost per 1M tokens for the follow-up meeting. Attaching the decision checklist + SLA draft we shared earlier.
